 How to Watch East Carolina vs Army
 When: Saturday, November 21, 2026
 Time: 12:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: CBS Sports Network
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 East Carolina has won three straight games after coming from behind to beat Charlotte 17-16 on Saturday, becoming bowl eligible for the third straight season. The Pirates struggled in the first half, committing four turnovers and falling behind 16-7 at halftime. Their defense took control after the break, however, holding Charlotte to just 22 yards of offense in the second half. Ashton Gray helped East Carolina cut into the lead with his second rushing touchdown before Noah Perez kicked a 43-yard field goal to give the Pirates the lead with 8:42 remaining. DJ Johnson Jr. sealed the comeback with an interception in the final two minutes.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Army is coming off a bye week following a 24-21 loss to Air Force on November 7. The Black Knights trailed 17-7 at halftime but rallied in the third quarter behind their rushing attack. Godspower Nwawuihe, who finished with 82 rushing yards, scored Army's first touchdown before quarterback Cale Hellums added a one-yard touchdown run. Backup quarterback Bryson Luter then broke free for a 19-yard score to give Army a 21-17 lead late in the third quarter. Air Force answered with a touchdown early in the fourth, and Army couldn't regain the lead despite stopping the Falcons on fourth down near its own goal line.
